experiment_name: Self-play training-plumbing smoke bit-exact reproducibility check (two independent runs, same seed)

algorithm_config.fix_under_test: scripts/selfplay_train_smoke.py now seeds Python random, NumPy, and torch RNGs (GLOBAL_SEED=42) before MonopolyZeroNet() is constructed, since its value_head is never overwritten by load_ppo_actor and was previously left at an unseeded random init
algorithm_config.game_decision_seed_logic: unchanged (SEEDS 501/502/503 per game, decision_seed derived internally by arena.play_game as before)

metrics.runtime_field_source: top-level runtime.wall_time_s is run1's `time -p` real value specifically (not an average of both runs); runtime.peak_rss_gib is copied verbatim from run1's own JSON output field of the same name (docs/baseline_runs/selfplay_repro_run1.json). Both runs' own figures are repeated below for completeness.

result: REPRODUCIBILITY PASSED. Two independent process launches of scripts/selfplay_train_smoke.py, same seed, same clean git HEAD (3b7db1f06bc60ca7f31497034efb42dd705e770e): every deterministic field matched exactly - positions_collected_total (709=709), per-game winners, batch_size_sampled, all four loss/train_step_stats values (bit-identical), and parameters_changed_count (16/16 both runs). Only elapsed_s and peak_rss_gib differed (timing/memory noise, expected). This confirms the RNG-seeding fix (Python/NumPy/torch seeded before MonopolyZeroNet construction) closed the previously-documented non-determinism gap. FixedAdapter.compatibility_fallbacks was read directly this time (0/0/0 for fixed-a/b/c in both runs) instead of left null.
notes: This entry corrects/supersedes the reproducibility caveat in 010-selfplay-training-plumbing-smoke.json's notes field, which reported non-byte-identical results (721 vs 697 positions) between two runs and attributed it to expected self_play=True exploration randomness. That attribution undercounted the actual cause: the model's value_head was also unseeded at construction time. Both are now fixed by explicit RNG seeding; 010's own numbers are left as originally recorded (historical record), not edited. [2026-08-11, later correction: this run and 010 both used the version of scripts/selfplay_train_smoke.py that imported monopoly_bench.adapters/arena/training, which load ASU_FROZEN_TEACHER into sys.modules as an import-time side effect even though no ASU output/teacher/label was ever used. Neither this entry's nor 010's actual results (positions, winners, loss, illegal actions, crashes) are affected or invalidated by that - only the code-cleanliness claim of being import-free was wrong. See 012-selfplay-asu-import-free-smoke.json for the corrected, genuinely ASU-import-free rerun, which reproduced these exact same numbers (709 positions, same winners, same loss) confirming the reimplementation is behaviorally equivalent, not just import-cleaner.] [2026-08-12 correction: runtime.wall_time_s/peak_rss_gib clarified as run1's measurement specifically (both were genuinely measured, not guessed) - see metrics.runtime_field_source and the per-run breakdown added there.]
